provenance.timing_order: Initial full run interleaved/randomised all three modes. Retained taskctl build later found dirty provenance. Final taskctl results are a separate clean-commit replay on the same host; final cross-tool comparison is unpaired. All measured data retained.

validation.claim_race_checks: One successful racer; same final owner; exactly seven claimed/conflict errors; no timeouts or unrelated errors.

paired_retained_binary.method: Fresh CLI processes; 2 warmups excluded; paired randomised order; warm OS cache; wait4 peak RSS; default commit policy; no race instrumentation
